teaser.en: A small rattlepod of the pea family: shake a dry pod and the seeds rattle inside.
teaser.sw: Mmea mdogo wa njuga (rattlepod) wa jamii ya kunde: tikisa ganda lililokauka na mbegu hulia ndani yake.
teaser.dg: Mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde wenye makakaya ganayopiga kululu: uchidindirisa kakaya kavu, tembe zinapiga kululu ndani.

summary.en: Mkelekele is a small herb of the pea family, a rattlepod with yellow flowers. Pakia's informants recognised it by its leaves.
summary.sw: Mkelekele ni mmea-shina laini mdogo wa jamii ya kunde, wa aina ya njuga (rattlepod), wenye maua ya manjano. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake.
summary.dg: *Mkelekele* ni mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde, mmea wa makakaya ganayopiga kululu (*rattlepod*), wenye maruwa ga rangi ya mandano. Atu ariouzwa ni Pakia aumanya kpwa makodzage.

about.en: *Mkelekele* is a low herb of the pea family. Its leaves are small, and the yellow pea-shaped flowers grow on short stalks. Like other rattlepods, its pods are inflated, and when they dry the loose seeds rattle inside. Pakia's informants identified it from the look of its leaves.
about.sw: *Mkelekele* ni mmea-shina laini mfupi wa jamii ya kunde. Majani yake ni madogo, na maua ya manjano yenye umbo la ua la kunde huota juu ya vikonyo vifupi. Kama mimea mingine ya njuga, maganda yake yamevimba, na yanapokauka mbegu zilizolegea hulia ndani yake. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa sura ya majani yake.
about.dg: *Mkelekele* ni mmea mdide mfupi wa jamii ya kunde. Makodzage ni madide, na maruwa ga rangi ya mandano, ga umbo dza ga maruwa ga kunde, ganamera dzulu ya milita mifupi. Dza mimea yanjina ya *rattlepod*, makakayage ganafutuka, na ganavyouma, tembe zirizo ndani, ambazo tazigbwirirwa ni chitu, zinapiga kululu.

where.en: Rattlepods grow in grassland, fallow fields and open sandy places. This species is known from the coasts of East Africa and Madagascar.
where.sw: Mimea ya njuga hukua katika nyasi, mashamba yaliyoachwa na maeneo ya wazi yenye mchanga. Spishi hii inajulikana katika pwani za Afrika Mashariki na Madagaska.
where.dg: Mimea ya *rattlepod* inamera mavuweni, minda iriyorichwa na phatu pha wazi phenye mtsanga. Aina hino inamanyikana kula pwani ya Afrika ya Mashariki na Madagascar.

names.en: Pakia records *mkelekele* with no English name and no meaning for the name. The Mgombato dictionary has a related entry, *mkelekele wa nyika*, for 'type of plant (Crotalaria sp.)', which suggests that *mkelekele* is a name for rattlepods more generally.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi *mkelekele* bila jina la Kiingereza na bila maana ya jina. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina kidahizo kinachohusiana, *mkelekele wa nyika*, kwa maana ya 'aina ya mmea (Crotalaria sp.)', jambo linaloashiria kwamba *mkelekele* ni jina la mimea ya njuga kwa ujumla zaidi.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika *mkelekele* bila dzina ra Chingereza na bila mana ya dzina. Kamusi ya Mgombato ina neno rinarohusiana nare, *mkelekele wa nyika*, ra 'aina ya mmea (*Crotalaria sp.*)', na hino inaonyesa kukala *mkelekele* rinaweza kukala ni dzina ra mimea yosi ya *rattlepod*.

reason.dg: *Tephrosia*, mmea wanjina mdide wa weruni wa jamii ya kunde

reason.dg: *Stylosanthes*, mmea mfupi wa jamii ya kunde wa phatu pha wazi

reason.dg: *Indigofera trita*, mmea mdide wa jamii ya kunde
